$comment: Products that may send analytics to POST /v1/analytics/collect (docs/analytics.md). origins: the live site's origins (env live). beta: the <beta>.hawkesgen.ai subdomain (env beta; pages under /c/<change>/ are env preview); betaOrigins: other origins that are the product's beta (env beta). http://localhost and 127.0.0.1 on any port are allowed for every product (env local). levels: the progression in order, for the default funnel (optional; otherwise levels are ordered by how players reach them). funnel: a site's own default funnel steps (funnel syntax, e.g. signup or level_start:level=1), used before levels. customEvents: how many distinct custom event names the product may use (default 50).
